    18	dwave-system
    19	============
    20	
    21	`dwave-system` is a basic API for easily incorporating the D-Wave system as a
    22	sampler in the
    23	`D-Wave Ocean software stack <https://docs.ocean.dwavesys.com/en/stable/overview/stack.html>`_,
    24	directly or through `Leap <https://cloud.dwavesys.com/leap/>`_\ 's cloud-based
    25	hybrid solvers. It includes ``DWaveSampler``, a dimod sampler that accepts and
    26	passes system parameters such as system identification and authentication down
    27	the stack, ``LeapHybridSampler``, for Leap's hybrid solvers, and other. It also
    28	includes several useful composites---layers of pre- and post-processing---that
    29	can be used with ``DWaveSampler`` to handle minor-embedding,
    30	optimize chain strength, etc.
    31	
    32	.. index-end-marker
